attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Behavioral Health Professionals (Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: APA- or Iowa Psychological Association-sponsored programs; workshops/conferences meeting the general criteria; academic courses (1 semester hour = 15 h); home study and electronic courses with certificate; mandatory reporter training; research, new course preparation and presentations (combined max 30 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal; hours earned from initial licensure until the second renewal may be used.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of the requirement may be carried into the next biennium if exceeded in the prior period.
rules.notes: Compliance period July 1 of an even year to June 30 of the next even year. 6 h: at second renewal in Iowa mental health law or risk management; later in ethics, federal or Iowa mental health law, or risk management. Mandatory reporter training (481-880.10(3)) can count. 1 h = 50 min.
rules.rule_quote: Each biennium, each person who is licensed to practice as a psychologist in this state shall be required to complete a minimum of 40 hours of continuing education approved by the board.
